# Repository metadata

About: Encrypted login vault for Flipper Zero. Types usernames and passwords over USB or BLE.

Topics: `flipper-zero`, `flipperzero`, `password-manager`, `flipper-app`, `momentum-firmware`, `hid-keyboard`, `aes-gcm`.

Repository settings are managed on GitHub, separately from branch contents. This file records the intended values. Security reports belong in private advisories or the email channel in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
